patch_description: The adaptive_polish with incremental updates already exists in the file (line 166 has the extended signature), so the failed edit is dropped. Instead, two complementary improvements: (1) add deterministic electrostatic-repulsion seeds to the seed bank — these spread-basin starts are strong priors for maximin/Heilbronn configurations; (2) add an "elite refinement" stage: after the multistart, take the winning configuration and re-run a short escape burst + low-temperature softmin Adam + extra-fine adaptive polish (with incremental updates, this is cheap) to squeeze additional min-area out of the global winner rather than only polishing per-seed.
